ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white ventral surface (approx. 85%) contrasted against low-intensity black trailing edges and focal spots (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edge boundary; high-density clusters of irregular black spots on the distal tips (left and right); scattered circular blobs throughout the medial zones; dense black-to-white gradient masking near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees; deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from fine jagged peaks (3-5 pixels) to larger blunt undulations (10-20 pixels) across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense focal clusters of dark circular pixels on the extreme lateral tips; isolated circular spots (3-15 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel rake marks; prominent diagonal line on the right lobe; series of vertical parallel lines located immediately left and right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Calcified, irregular protrusion on the far-left distal tip (consistent with barnacle colonization); multiple parallel rake-mark scars visible across the mid-section of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled 'splash' pattern of black pixels radiating downward from the median notch onto the white ventral field.
